name: John Doe
headline: Senior Software Engineer
summary: Senior Software Engineer with 8+ years of experience building distributed systems and cloud-native applications. Expertise in Python, Go, and Kubernetes. Led teams at two FAANG companies delivering high-scale services.

bullets: Designed and implemented a real-time data pipeline processing 10M+ events/day using Kafka and Flink
Migrated 50+ microservices from monolithic deployment to Kubernetes, reducing deployment time by 80%
Led a team of 5 engineers delivering quarterly OKRs ahead of schedule
Built RESTful API layer serving 500K+ daily active users using Python (FastAPI) and PostgreSQL
Reduced p99 latency from 2.3s to 180ms through query optimization and caching strategy
Implemented CI/CD pipeline with GitHub Actions, reducing release cycle from 2 weeks to daily
